name: jobradar
description: Run a job search from inside Claude Code: /jobradar setup writes your profile and grading rubric from a five-question interview, /jobradar today collects from Korean boards (사람인, 원티드, 점핏, 링커리어, 네이버, 라인, 우아한형제들) and global ATS boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever), grades every posting A/B/C against your rubric with one line of reasoning, and writes RADAR.md with the few worth reading. It never applies to anything.
